name: source_object
description: GCS object path containing the source SCHEDULE publication.

name: source_generation
description: GCS generation identifying the exact physical version of the source object.

name: publication_sequence
description: Network Rail publication sequence number used to identify and order SCHEDULE publications.

name: extract_type
description: SCHEDULE extract type from the publication metadata; expected values are 'full' or 'update'.

name: transaction_type
description: Source transaction type for the TIPLOC record; expected values are 'Create', 'Update' or 'Delete'. Full extracts are expected to contain only 'Create' records.

name: tiploc_code
description: TIPLOC code identifying the timing point location.

name: tps_description
description: Timing Point System description of the location.

name: description
description: Short description of the location. Not populated for every TIPLOC.

name: crs_code
description: CRS (3-alpha) code for the location. Not all timing points have a CRS code.

name: stanox
description: STANOX (station number) used by operational railway systems. Not all TIPLOCs have a STANOX.

name: nalco
description: NLC (National Location Code) associated with the TIPLOC.
